answers.ask: Is the store enterable, or exterior only? Going inside is a noticeably slower build.
answers.answer: Make the IKEA store exterior only; the main scene is the hill, road, and sunset view.

answers.ask: What do players do here besides hang out - is there a shopping or job loop?
answers.answer: There is no shopping or job loop; this is a simple third-person roleplay and hangout scene.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D third-person roleplay hangout scene on a hill at sunset. The player spawn sits on the hillside in the foreground, looking downhill toward a road running across the lower area; across the road stands a massive IKEA-style store shown as an exterior only. Frame the scene around the open hill, road, large store facade, and warm sunset view.
agent_notes: The prompt self-declares as a third-person roleplay game and the author confirmed it is a simple roleplay and hangout scene with no shopping or job loop, so this is Roleplay & Avatar Sim with the housing model settled as none at all: nothing is claimed or built, so settlement-static is the shape and Morph Roleplay is the preset whose static-scene bundle of a gathering spot, scenic backdrops and a landmark is exactly this build. The massive IKEA is landmark-focal and stays exterior-only on the author's instruction, which is what keeps this off P3. The hill players spawn at the foot of is terrain-relief, so the route is P0 with tiered elevation and nothing overhanging. Decided without a user: the requested road is emitted as path-road-vehicle because it is a car-scale road crossed to reach a big-box store rather than pedestrian circulation, though no drivable cars were asked for, and the sunset view down the hill is the photo vignette.
